section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a study conducted in March 2010, which recruited women over 18 in the United States through online advertisements on various internet forums, listservs, and Facebook. Participants completed an initial online questionnaire covering sociodemographics, health indicators, body appreciation, and sexual health, followed by a 35-day daily diary component. The results discussed in this paper pertain to the initial questionnaire.
